main.description: Links a community.lexicon.calendar.event to a scene. Created by scene builders to curate the scene calendar. The event itself lives in the shared community namespace; this sidecar adds scene context.

scene.description: Reference to the scene this event belongs to.

curatedBy.description: DID of the scene builder who curated this event onto the scene calendar.

visibility.description: Override the scene's default visibility for this specific event.

pinned.description: Whether this event is pinned to the top of the scene calendar.
